title: Settlement read
description: Which way this venue's market would settle if it closed right now. The live price is compared with the settlement anchor.

state.label: Settlement state
state.description: Tracking while the price sits clear of the anchor, pinned when it is within a hair of it. Pinned rounds can flip on the last tick.

side_if_settled_now.label: Winning now
side_if_settled_now.description: Up or Down, whichever would win if the round closed this second. It changes every time the price crosses the anchor.

distance_bps.label: Distance to strike
distance_bps.description: How far the price is from the anchor, in basis points. Positive means above it and Up is winning.
